title: BIS Publishes IS 20201:2026 Standard for Community Seed Bank Management
summary: Establishes India's 1st management framework for community-led seed banks.

blocks.title: 📰 1. 💰 ESI, FINANCE & BUSINESS NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 BIS Publishes IS 20201:2026 Standard for Community Seed Bank Management. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Establishes India's 1st management framework for community-led seed banks.
New Standard: Published by BIS Biodiversity Sectional Committee (EED 06) under Environment Department.
NFSNM Support: National Food Security and Nutrition Mission provides ₹50 lakh one-time assistance for community seed banks.
Statutory Protection: Aligns with PPV&FRA 2001 and Biological Diversity Act 2002.
⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on institutional financial products, interest margins, capital adequacy ratios, and digital payment infrastructure.
